core.title: Camelot Handleset Bottom Only, Schlage FC285CAM
tags: Bottom Only Camelot Handleset with No Deadbolts

text.description_html:
Schlage FC285CAM, Camelot Handleset Grip Bottom Only

This is a custom handleset. It comes packaged with the Schlage Custom Camelot Handleset Grip and your Whitney Lever with Alden Rose. No deadbolt.

Features and Specifications of the Bottom Only Camelot Handleset with No Deadbolt:

  • Exterior Total Projection: 2-15/16"
  • Exterior Center to Center Grip Range: adjustable 8-3/8" to 9-7/8"
  • Exterior Deadbolt Escutcheon Height: 3-3/8"
  • Exterior Deadbolt Escutcheon Width: 3"
  • Exterior Top Grip Escutcheon Width: 3"
  • Exterior Grip Height: 12-1/2"
  • Backset: will fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: will fit 1-5/8" up to 1-3/4" packaged with extra screws to accommodate 2" doors
  • Interior Trim: Whitney Lever with Alden Rose
  • Finish: Satin Brass

Custom item, NOT Returnable
